page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance running on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 7T83 processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz, it supplies 128 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of memory. This hardware allocation establishes a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, providing 2.0 GB of memory per processing core.

The server provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. It contains no local NVMe storage, requiring all persistent data to be backed by remote block storage volumes. Additionally, the instance excludes discrete GPU hardware accelerators. The omission of attached local disks and graphics processors focuses infrastructure overhead strictly on CPU execution and network throughput.

A dense 128-core setup paired with a lean memory footprint maximizes compute efficiency for multithreaded tasks without paying for unused memory overhead or unneeded local SSD capacity. This profile fits high-performance computing (HPC), electronic design automation (EDA), batch execution, financial modeling, and distributed code compilation workloads.
